title: The story is the order, not the broadcast
text: Material moves to where the viewer needs it: the "why 500k" answer right where the number comes up, the voice recording right after "it was still 500,000" as proof, the host's recap of what was paid at the end of a story part, the lawyer's legal framing after the events it explains (events first, law second).
